coverage.note: Entry-fill friction only — ExecutionAgent models slippage, half-spread and market impact on the ENTRY. Exit friction is not modelled, so real round-trip cost is HIGHER than this figure, not lower.

friction_vs_edge.note: Entry friction only — the true round-trip ratio is WORSE than this. A ratio near or below 1 means the strategy is paying most of its edge away to get in.
